snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Official Game Trailer - Nintendo E3 2016
snippet.description:
Check out the official game trailer for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild from E3 2016. The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is avaliable now for Nintendo Switch: https://zelda.nintendo.com/breath-of-the-wild/

Step into a world of discovery, exploration and adventure in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a boundary-breaking new game in the acclaimed series. Travel across fields, through forests and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the ruined kingdom of Hyrule in this stunning open-air adventure.

#BreathoftheWild #LegendofZelda #NintendoSwitch

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
